leadText: Omega (Japanese: オメガ Omega) is a character of the day who appeared in Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!. He participated in the Club Battle tournament, but lost in a battle against Dino and was knocked out of the very first round.
plainText:
Omega (Japanese: オメガ Omega) is a character of the day who appeared in Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!. He participated in the Club Battle tournament, but lost in a battle against Dino and was knocked out of the very first round.

==Pokémon==
 

Omega has at least two other Pokémon, as those who entered the Club Battle were required to enter with three Pokémon.

==Pokémon competitions==
Club Battle - Top 16 (Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!)

==Voice actors==
